name: Captain Slave
original_name: キャプテン・スレイブ
source:
Captain Surei was the galaxy's most infamous space pirate.

He regained consciousness to find himself in young girl's body, being sold as a slave.

How dare his captor treat the great Captain Surei this way? But in his current form there was nothing he could do. He was purchased, as a girl, and his training began.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ013196.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
